'''Tiero''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] male during the time of the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. Working as the foreman on [[The Ark|Project Failsafe]], Tiero under the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Veedrig]] reported unsafe work practices and corruption when the Republic strike force entered the secret facility in the hollowed-out [[Giant's Spear]] mesa. After said force commandeered ''[[the Ark]]'' and deposed Veedrig, Tiero was given the responsibility of finishing the massive starship's construction before the predicted destruction of the planet.
